name: HLV-772
composition: Active: HLV-772 400 mg (small molecule, contains an aniline group and a basic amine, lipophilic, cleared by CYP3A4). Excipients: lactose, polysorbate 80, magnesium stearate.
dose: 800 mg once daily by mouth, escalating to 1200 mg
patients: Adults 18 to 85 with advanced lung cancer, including patients with moderate liver impairment (Child-Pugh B)
trial_design: First in human, 6 participants per dose group dosed on the same day
known_lab_data: Animal studies: mild liver enzyme rise in rats at high dose. No heart (hERG) testing done yet.
